The selected value is development-only and is not a production config or release threshold.

metric_contract.final_review_metrics: Evidence Atom Recall, Candidate Precision, nDCG at final K=1/3/5/8; MRR_FINAL@8 is the downstream-visible final-review MRR only.
metric_contract.raw_pool_metrics: Raw dense diagnostics are named MRR_RAW@20, MRR_RAW@32, MRR_RAW@48, MRR_RAW@64 and are never mixed with MRR_FINAL@8.
metric_contract.mrr_final_at_8: Mean reciprocal rank of the first frozen Gold grade >=2 candidate in final returned Top8; misses contribute 0 over all cases.
metric_contract.candidate_precision: Frozen Gold grade >=2 candidates divided by requested final K; denominator remains requested K when final pool is short.
